title: SparseEngine: Sparse-First Inference Engine
abstract: arXiv:2609.39068v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that strain KV-cache memory and attention computation. Although sparse attention reduces these costs, heterogeneous cache representations and workflows hinder integration with existing inference engines, while prior sparse-serving abstractions support only specific layouts or workflows. We present SparseEngine, a ground-up, sparse-first inference engine whose shared lifecycle contract lets each method control its KV representation and computation while coordinating state transitions with common serving infrastructure. SparseEngine supports 15 methods across four categories and enables cross-request state management through Chain Cache, which resumes KV-eviction methods from retained history, and controllable Prefix-Cache Pruning, which removes KV from selected history regions while preserving logical-prefix matching. While maintaining method quality, SparseEngine delivers over 10x

translated_abstract: 长上下文大语言模型（LLM）智能体会不断积累交互历史，给KV缓存的内存占用和注意力计算带来巨大压力。尽管稀疏注意力可以降低这些开销，但异构的缓存表示和工作流阻碍了其与现有推理引擎的集成，而此前的稀疏服务抽象仅支持特定的布局或工作流。我们提出了SparseEngine——一个从零构建的、稀疏优先的推理引擎，其共享的生命周期契约让每种方法都能控制自身的KV表示和计算，同时与通用服务基础设施协调状态转换。SparseEngine支持四大类别的15种方法，并通过Chain Cache（可从保留的历史中恢复KV驱逐方法的执行）和可控的前缀缓存剪枝（在从选定历史区域移除KV的同时保持逻辑前缀匹配）实现跨请求的状态管理。在保持各方法质量的同时，SparseEngine带来了超过10倍的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SparseEngine是一个从零构建的稀疏优先推理引擎，通过共享生命周期契约统一支持四大类的15种稀疏注意力方法，并借助Chain Cache与可控前缀缓存剪枝实现跨请求KV状态管理，在保持方法质量的同时带来超过10倍的效率提升。
en_tdlr: SparseEngine is a ground-up sparse-first inference engine that unifies 15 sparse attention methods across four categories under a shared lifecycle contract and enables cross-request KV state management via Chain Cache and controllable prefix-cache pruning, delivering over 10x efficiency gains while preserving method quality.
